### Summary

Much more personal than standard corporate histories, David Packard's The HP Way provides insights into managing and motivating people and inspiration for wouldbe entrepreneurs. This bestselling classic joins the Collins Business Essentials lineup with a new Note from Steve Jobs.From a onecargarage company to a multibilliondollar industry, the rise of HewlettPackard is an extraordinary tale of vision, innovation and hard work. Conceived in 1939, HewlettPackard earned success not only as a result of its engineering knowhow and cuttingedge product ideas, but also because of the unique management style it developed a way of doing things called 'the HP way'.Decades before today's creative management trends, HewlettPackard invented such strategies as 'walkaround management', 'flextime', and 'quality cycles'. Always sensitive to the needs of its customers and responsive to employee input, HewlettPackard earned massive steady growth that far outshone its competitors' vacillating fortunes, even with radically different products from those responsible for its initial boom.For entrepreneurs and managers alike, the wisdom found in these pages is invaluable if they want their businesses to gain steady growth and consistent success.

### The Hard Thing About Hard Things By Ben Horowitz

'The Hard Thing About Hard Things' tells the story of how computer science graduate Ben Horowitz came to be regarded as one of the world's most respected techpreneurs. Based on his varied experiences, from how to run a start-up to wisdom about dealing with uncontrollables, this 9-part series is an entrepreneur’s guide to survival.

Entrepreneurship

Decision-Making

Leadership

Content Rating: U

### Episodes

#### 1. Straight From The Horse's Mouth

02:22 min

When Ben Horowitz gets real about the 'hard things' any business leader has to face, you have to listen. It won't always be easy but he can show you how to thrive.

#### 2. You Can't Control Everything

02:21 min

Watch Horowitz guide chief execs on how to accept situations that are out of their sphere of control.

#### 3. Dealing With The "Struggle"

02:35 min

If you have made the first mistake in your endeavor, worry not, Horowitz has the answer. Find out how to get your act together as soon as you realize your mistake.

#### 4. Get The Hiring Right

02:46 min

The success story of an organization is written by its people. Perfect the rules of hiring with Horowitz who drives home the point with a personal example.

#### 5. Make It A Great Place To Work

02:32 min

Culture impacts and drives the performance of any business. Learn how to design the culture of your workplace.

#### 6. Harness The Network

02:37 min

You can figure out solutions by learning the hard way. Or you can build a network of seasoned, successful people and ask them how they did it.

#### 7. Mistakes Are Just Lessons

02:13 min

How CEOs react to errors in judgement can make all the difference. A mistake is not failure. Learn to deal with it head-on and chalk it up to experience.

#### 8. The Challenges Of War And Peace

02:40 min

CEOs need to change their tactics just like any military general. Go on a war footing when the stability of the company is under threat but ease up when the going is good.

#### 9. Selling Your Baby

02:08 min

The hardest thing for any entrepreneur is to give up control or ownership of the business they have created. How will you know if it is the right time to bite the bullet?--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

4. Effective executives concentrate on the few major areas

5. Effective executives, finally, make effective decisions.
They know that this is, above all, a matter of system—of the
rightsteps in therightsequence. They knowthataneffective de
cision is always a judgment based on "dissenting opinions"

What is needed are few, but fundamental, decisions. What is
needed is the right strategy ratherthan razzle-dazzle tactics.
These are the elements of executive effectiveness—and these
